name: SAR Filing by MLRO — Participant Interaction Matrix
description: Defines how each participant interacts with the SAR filing journey: what data they see, what actions they can perform, and what they are explicitly prohibited from seeing. The central control is the POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition — PER-001 (Customer) must receive zero information about SAR activities at any point.
tipping_off_enforcement_note: POCA 2002 s333A makes it a criminal offence to disclose to a subject of a SAR, or to any person, that a SAR has been made or that a money laundering investigation is being or may be carried out. All participant interactions are designed with this prohibition as the primary constraint. Any system, notification, or communication that could constitute tipping-off must be reviewed and approved by the MLRO before deployment.

participants.persona_description: The bank's nominated officer and SMF17 holder. Holds personal criminal liability under POCA 2002 s331 for failures in SAR reporting. Full access to all SAR investigation data, case management workflow, and submission controls.
participants.role_in_journey: Primary actor. Owns all phases of the SAR filing journey end-to-end.
participants.authentication_requirements: Step-up MFA required for SAR workflow access — beyond standard employee authentication. Hardware token or biometric required. Separate role-gated application — not accessible from standard compliance desktop.

actions: Receives secure internal notification of new trigger (automated event or staff disclosure)
Reviews trigger details in SARInvestigationRecord
Confirms or modifies trigger classification
Assigns investigation to self or Deputy MLRO (PER-053)
data_visible: Trigger event details: event type, source service, timestamp
Staff disclosure: submitting staff member identity, disclosure narrative

notifications_received.content: New suspicious activity trigger: [trigger_type]. Investigation ID: [investigation_id]. Customer ref: [internal_ref]. Requires MLRO review.

actions: Reads Customer record (ENT-001) — full identity data
Reads KycAssessment (ENT-003) — PEP/sanctions screening results, risk score, EDD history
Reads transaction history via SVC-001 read API
Reads prior SARs for this customer (if any)
Adds evidence items to SARInvestigationRecord
Records timeline entries documenting investigation steps
Requests additional information from operational staff (without disclosing SAR reason)
Reviews adverse media data
data_visible: KycAssessment: all fields including sanctions_screening_result and pep_screening_result
Transaction history: full account activity for relevant period

actions: Records formal decision (file_sar | file_defensive_sar | dismiss)
Documents decision rationale — must be specific and legally defensible
Confirms understanding of 5-business-day SLA
If dismiss: closes SARInvestigationRecord with documented rationale
Completes NCA SAR form fields in SVC-014 case management
Reviews draft SAR for completeness and accuracy
Confirms tipping-off risk review (mandatory checkbox before submission is enabled)
Marks SAR as ready_for_submission
form_controls: Grounds of suspicion — free text, minimum 100 characters enforced
Subject details — linked to Customer ENT-001 but anonymised in NCA form
Typology selector — NCA SAR typology codes
Consent request toggle — if SAR requires NCA consent for a transaction

actions: Triggers SAR submission to NCA SAR Online
Reviews NCA acknowledgement and reference number
Confirms SLA compliance (filed within 5 business days)
data_visible: SuspiciousActivityReport: all fields including NCA reference on return

notifications_received.content: SAR [sar_id] successfully submitted. NCA reference: [nca_reference]. Filed at: [filed_date]. SLA status: [within_sla | breached].

actions: Monitors NCA consent response via SAR Online (if consent SAR)
Determines whether account restrictions are required
Instructs SVC-001 to apply account restrictions via SARFiled event (if needed)
Closes SARInvestigationRecord on resolution
Records SAR outcome for annual MLRO report
decisions_made: Flag for enhanced ongoing monitoring: yes/no
Escalate to law enforcement contact: yes/no

participants.audit_trail: All MLRO actions in the SAR workflow are immutably logged to SVC-103 with MLRO identity, timestamp, and action detail. Audit log is classified as auditor_only and retained for 7 years WORM.

participants.persona_description: Delegated authority from PER-052. May carry out investigation phases and SAR preparation under MLRO supervision. Cannot submit SARs without MLRO sign-off except where explicitly delegated in the MLRO's statement of responsibilities.
participants.role_in_journey: Delegated investigator. May perform SAR-PH-002 and SAR-PH-004 activities. All submissions must be confirmed by MLRO (PER-052).
participants.access_constraints: Same step-up MFA requirement as MLRO. Access restricted to investigations explicitly assigned to PER-053 by PER-052.
prohibited_actions: Cannot make the formal SAR decision (SAR-PH-003) without MLRO authorisation
Cannot submit SAR to NCA without MLRO sign-off
Cannot dismiss an investigation without MLRO sign-off

participants.persona_description: The individual who is the subject of the SAR investigation. Under POCA 2002 s333A this person must never be told that a SAR has been filed or is under consideration.
participants.role_in_journey: NONE — the customer has no role in this journey and must receive no information relating to it.

interactions_by_phase.data_visible: NONE — zero access to any SAR-related data, records, events, or communications
interactions_by_phase.notifications_received: NONE — no notifications of any kind are sent to PER-001 at any stage of this journey
prohibited: Customer must not receive any communication referencing a SAR, suspicious activity investigation, NCA, or POCA
Customer must not see any account status message that reveals a SAR is the cause of any account restriction — generic 'account under review' language only
Customer must not see SARFiled, SARInvestigationOpened, SARDecisionMade, SARConsentRequested, or SARConsentGranted events reflected in any customer-facing interface
Any customer-facing account restriction notice must use language pre-approved by the MLRO and Legal to avoid tipping-off risk

account_restriction_customer_view.description: If account restrictions are applied following SAR filing, the customer may notice that their account is restricted. The only permissible communication is a generic 'your account is temporarily under review' message — no reference to financial crime, SAR, NCA, or POCA.
account_restriction_customer_view.approved_language: Your account is currently subject to a review. We are unable to process this transaction at this time. Please contact us if you have any questions.
prohibited_language: Any reference to money laundering, financial crime, suspicious activity
Any reference to NCA, POCA, Terrorism Act, or MLR
Any statement that a report has been made
Any statement that the bank suspects illegal activity

participants.persona_description: System participant. Receives all SAR-related events for immutable WORM audit logging. No human access except through auditor-only access controls.
participants.role_in_journey: Passive auditor. Receives and stores all events immutably.
participants.human_access: Auditor-only access — requires dual-person integrity (two senior compliance officers) and is logged separately. No operational staff can access SAR audit records.

notification_matrix.description: Summary of all notifications in this journey — confirms customer receives nothing

notifications.content_summary: SAR submission confirmation with NCA reference

notifications.trigger: SLA warning — 4 business days elapsed since decision
notifications.channel: Secure internal case management system — automated SLA alert
notifications.content_summary: SAR SLA warning: 1 business day remaining to file
NO NOTIFICATION — tipping-off prohibition strictly applied. Zero communications to customer.
